parent_objective: design a regret-boundary retargeting source repair around viable action-divergent low-regret rows
blocked_by: M1260 classifies M1259 pair 5 as viable action-divergent low-regret

public_gates: M1261 must preserve actor input contract
M1261 must not use private holdout
M1261 must preserve strict accepted-source criteria
M1261 must design a bounded retargeting run or reject it
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, fault labels, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not accept negative own-branch margins
do not treat asymmetric_success_drop as strict accepted source-positive
do not claim current single-track proxies are true single-wheel or per-wheel faults

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs one bounded retargeting variable aimed at increasing two-sided cross-regret while preserving own-branch viability
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, high-fidelity, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design lowers strict thresholds
stop if design only targets own-branch viability without cross-regret
stop if design would count collision-dominated rows as success
fallback_plan: if a bounded retargeting implementation is straightforward, pre-register one no-training smoke
if current artifacts lack enough replay data, pre-register an implementation-only extractor
if retargeting is too unconstrained, route to source-branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1260 admits one regret-boundary retarget design

admission_evidence: M1259 pair 5 is viable and action-divergent but low-regret
M1260 blocks training and direct source reruns
allowed_updates: one bounded next-run manifest if design admits it
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: design identifies retarget axes and runtime bounds
design states strict acceptance and anti-collision-dominance checks
design admits or rejects one bounded no-training smoke

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1261 designs a source retargeter and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until strict source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If retargeting cannot preserve viability while increasing regret, record it as source-shape evidence and do not lower thresholds.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, true high-fidelity fault, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1259's viable action-divergent low-regret pair can motivate a bounded retargeting design that targets two-sided cross-regret rather than only viability.
success_criteria: design admits or rejects one bounded no-training smoke
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design ignores M1260 strict negative audit
design targets only viability and not regret
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

commands.name: design
commands.command: write docs/m1261-paper-route-richer-fault-regret-boundary-retarget-design.md from M1260 audit and M1259 artifacts

decision_rule: M1261 passes if it writes a design for one bounded regret-boundary retargeting step or rejects the idea without training or threshold relaxation.
